property_summary: After approveMax, imBalances of any address remains zero if that address never called supplyTokenTo.
After approveMax, the sum of all imBalances is not increased relative to total credits deposited (credits issued minus credits burned) unless new deposits occur.
After approveMax, imBalances for any address that did not call supplyTokenTo remains zero.
After approveMax, imBalances of the caller is unchanged if the caller never called redeemToken.
After approveMax, the imBalances of any address k equals the sum of credits deposited minus credits redeemed for that address.
After calling approveMax(), imBalances for any address other than this contract (or possibly any address) never decreases from its previous value.
After calling approveMax, the imBalances of any address never decreases from its previous value.
After calling approveMax(), the imBalances of any address never decreases from its previous value.
After approveMax(), imBalances(to) is greater than or equal to imBalances(to) before for any user to, when the caller is the owner and the transaction does not revert.
approveMax() does not change imBalances for any address
After calling approveMax, the imBalances of the owner remains zero.
After calling approveMax(), the imBalances of the contract owner (deployer) is zero.
After approveMax(), imBalances of any address is unchanged from before the call.
After any sequence of operations including a call to approveMax(), imBalances of any address that was never supplied to is zero.
After calling approveMax, the sum of all imBalances does not decrease.
After calling approveMax(), the imBalances mapping remains unchanged for all addresses.
After calling approveMax(), the value of imBalances for any address is equal to the original balance of that address before the call.
After approveMax(), the imBalances of the caller is unchanged.
After calling approveMax(), the imBalances of all addresses remain the same as before the call.
After calling approveMax(), the imBalances of the contract caller (msg.sender) is unchanged from before the call.
After calling approveMax(), the sum of imBalances across all callers remains unchanged from before the call, because approveMax() does not modify imBalances.
For any address k, calling approveMax() never changes the value of imBalances(k).
After calling approveMax(), the imBalances of any address remains unchanged from before the call.

After calling approveMax(), the imBalances of the first address used in a supplyTokenTo call remains unchanged from its value immediately before the approveMax() call, even though the underlying savings contract's exchange rate may have changed.
After calling approveMax(), imBalances[msg.sender] equals the sum of credits issued from all supplyTokenTo calls made by msg.sender, regardless of any preceding approveMax() calls.
The depositToken function always returns the address of the underlying mAsset after approveMax is called.
The depositToken function returns a non-zero address after approveMax is called.
There exists at least one address whose imBalances is zero after calling approveMax.
After calling approveMax, the depositToken function returns the same address as the underlying mAsset stored in the contract.
After approveMax is called, depositToken() returns a non-zero address that matches the address of the underlying mAsset.
For any address, the product of its imBalance and the exchange rate is always greater than or equal to the amount of mAssets returned by balanceOfToken.
The balanceOfToken result for a given address is always greater than or equal to the imBalance of that address times 1e18 divided by the exchange rate.
For any address, balanceOfToken returns the same value as imBalances[address] * exchangeRate / 1e18, when exchangeRate is not zero.
For any address, balanceOfToken returns the same value before and after calling approveMax.
For any address, balanceOfToken returns a value that is at most imBalances[address] * 1e18 / exchangeRate (the buggy formula).
For any address, balanceOfToken should return a value less than or equal to the product of credits and exchangeRate when exchangeRate is less than or equal to 1e18.
After calling approveMax(), the token balance returned by balanceOfToken is at most the product of imBalances and exchangeRate.
balanceOfToken returns a value divisible by 1e18.
balanceOfToken returns a value that when multiplied by 1e18 equals the product of imBalances and exchangeRate.
balanceOfToken returns a value that is at most the product of imBalances and exchangeRate when exchangeRate is less than or equal to 1e18.
balanceOfToken should be monotonic with respect to imBalances, i.e., larger imBalances should never yield a smaller balanceOfToken due to overflow or other errors.
balanceOfToken always returns a value >= 1e18 when imBalances[addr] > 0 and exchangeRate > 0.
balanceOfToken returns a value that is a multiple of 1e18 when imBalances[addr] is 0.
For any address, the return value of balanceOfToken is divisible by 1e18 when imBalances[addr] is zero.
After approveMax(), for any address, balanceOfToken(addr) modulo 1e18 equals 0.
balanceOfToken returns (imBalances[addr] * exchangeRate) / 1e18 for any address.
balanceOfToken returns a value divisible by 1e18 for any address
For any address, balanceOfToken always returns a value that is at least the amount of mAsset deposited (i.e., balanceOfToken(addr) >= imBalances[addr]) after a approveMax() call.
After approveMax(), the return value of balanceOfToken(addr) is the same as the internal imBalances[addr] scaled by exchangeRate / 1e18.
After approveMax(), for any address, balanceOfToken returns a value that is an exact multiple of 1e18.
The balanceOfToken function returns a value that is always non-negative and equal to the product of imBalances and exchangeRate divided by 1e18.
balanceOfToken returns a value that is proportional to imBalances and exchangeRate, with the property that multiplying the returned balance by 1e18 equals imBalances multiplied by exchangeRate.
The balanceOfToken function returns a value that is always strictly less than the sum of imBalances and exchangeRate.
balanceOfToken returns the product of imBalances and exchangeRate divided by 1e18.
The balanceOfToken returns the same value as imBalances[addr] * exchangeRate / 1e18.
balanceOfToken returns imBalances[addr] * exchangeRate / 1e18 for all addresses.
For the same address, balanceOfToken returns an invariant consistent value across multiple calls.
For any address, balanceOfToken returns a non-negative integer equal to weighted sum of imBalances[addr] and exchangeRate.
For an address that never supplied tokens, balanceOfToken returns 0.
After approveMax(), balanceOfToken returns the same value as before approveMax() for any address.
For any user and any amount, redeemToken returns a value equal to the amount requested.
For any user and any amount, redeemToken's call to savings.redeemUnderlying does not modify the caller's internal balance if the call reverts.
After calling redeemToken, the internal balance of msg.sender is less than or equal to its value before the call.
After redeeming, the user's internal balance divided by the exchange rate plus the withdrawn underlying amount is at most their initial underlying balance before the redeem.
After redeemToken, the internal balance of msg.sender decreases by the exact amount of credits burned.
